s1.title: Your pulse in the scene
s1.desc: Week streak, points, badges and dances: your real activity at a glance.

s2.title: Social ↔ Academy
s2.desc: Two worlds in one app: Social for events, dances and friends; Academy for classes and your learning. Switch it here.

s3.title: The bell
s3.desc: Everything lands here: gifted tickets, confirmed table reservations, friend requests and notices from your events.

s4.title: The lineup
s4.desc: All of Santiago's socials: filter by style or venue, buy your presale and book a table for your group.

s5.title: The + button
s5.desc: Your QR (your ticket at the door and how you log dances on the floor), your Dances history and the community's informal Practices.

s6.title: Your friends
s6.desc: Build your crew: see who's going to each event, check their upcoming outings and gift them tickets from checkout.

s7.title: Your profile
s7.desc: Photo, styles you dance and your lenses: if you're also an instructor, DJ, producer or run an academy, switch view here.

s1.title: Your learning
s1.desc: Attendance, classes taken and your progress as a student, at a glance.

s2.title: Social ↔ Academy
s2.desc: You're in Academy mode. Go back to Social for the events lineup, your dances and your crew.

s3.title: The bell
s3.desc: Notices land here: class bookings, confirmations and news from your academies.

s4.title: Classes
s4.desc: Explore classes and private lessons from all academies, book your spot and check your history.

s5.title: The + button
s5.desc: Your personal QR. It's also your credential in classes and socials.

s6.title: Academies
s6.desc: The scene's directory: discover academies, see their classes and enroll. If you're already in one, My Learning lives here.

s7.title: Your profile
s7.desc: Photo, styles and your lenses. Switch back to Social view whenever you want to go dancing.

s1.title: Filter by style
s1.desc: Salsa, bachata or timba? Tap a chip to see only those nights. You can combine several.

s2.title: By venue
s2.desc: Fan of a place? See only its lineup, and open its profile for the address and directions.

s3.title: Three ways to see
s3.desc: List, weekly calendar or venue map: choose how to explore the scene.

s4.title: My tickets
s4.desc: The ticket icon takes you to your wallet: your tickets with QR, the ones you bought and the ones you were gifted.

s5.title: Tap an event
s5.desc: Each card opens the detail: lineup, plan of the night and prices. In checkout you can gift tickets to friends or book a table.

s1.title: List or calendar
s1.desc: List grouped by day or weekly calendar; also inside Explore, to see the scene's full week.

s2.title: Explore academies
s2.desc: All the scene's classes, not just your academies'. Booking requires an active enrollment.

s3.title: Explore and book
s3.desc: Filter by day, style and level. Each card shows the remaining spots and books with one tap.

s1.title: Your personal QR
s1.desc: It renews itself so nobody can copy it. At the door it's your ticket; on the floor, it logs dances with your partner.

s2.title: Scanner mode
s2.desc: Switch to Scan to log a dance with your partner's QR. It lands in your Dances history.

s1.title: Build your crew
s1.desc: Search them by name or share your invite link. Whoever opens it lands straight on adding you.

s2.title: Your friends are going to
s2.desc: The events where someone from your crew already has a ticket, so you don't hit the floor alone.

s3.title: Your list
s3.desc: Pending requests and your friends. Open their profile to see their styles and which events they're going to.

s1.title: To confirm
s1.desc: The night's live dance invites: accept them or let them pass, without anyone knowing.

s2.title: Your last social
s2.desc: How many dances, how many different partners, your average and the best dance of the night: your retrospective.

s3.title: Your history
s3.desc: All your nights grouped by event: who took you out to dance, who you rated and how much you danced.

s1.title: All or yours
s1.desc: Filter between all the community's practices and only the ones you organize or attend, and by style.

s2.title: Create yours
s2.desc: Getting together to train, reviewing a class or a warm-up before the social? Create your practice with spots and a place.

s3.title: The practices
s3.desc: Grouped by day: time, place, who's hosting and how many are going. Tap one to confirm your attendance.

s1.title: Your identity
s1.desc: Photo, name and Instagram: what your friends and your dance partners see.

s2.title: Act as
s2.desc: Switch the whole app's lens: dancer, staff, producer, academy… the nav and home transform.

s3.title: Streak and badges
s3.desc: Earned by dancing: consecutive weeks on the floor and achievements for real behaviors. There's no public ranking.

s1.title: Your month at a glance
s1.desc: Scheduled events, tickets sold, monthly billing and pending collections: the pulse of your production.

s2.title: Payments to review
s2.desc: Transfers and manual payments waiting for your validation. Approve or reject them from the detail — the full queue lives in Receipts.

s3.title: Your best nights
s3.desc: Top 5 by billing and by attendance: which date worked and which is worth repeating.

s4.title: Your events
s4.desc: Create and manage every event: prices, lineup, reservable tables, guest lists, discount codes and door staff.

s5.title: All the modules
s5.desc: Receipts, codes, CRM, analytics and your settings — defaults, payment methods, Pro subscription and appearance — from the menu.

s6.title: The bell
s6.desc: Every ticket sale and every new receipt lands here. Nothing slips by.

s1.title: Your week
s1.desc: The classes you teach, your next-7-days schedule and marked attendance — your operation at a glance.

s2.title: Upcoming classes
s2.desc: The classes ahead with their fill. Tap one to see the roster and mark attendance.

s3.title: My classes
s3.desc: Your class console: full roster for each one. You can mark present from 30 minutes before to 30 after the start.

s4.title: Students
s4.desc: Search them by name and check their attendance history — quick read, no editing.

s5.title: The bell
s5.desc: We let you know when a class is assigned to you and 30 and 10 minutes before each one.

s6.title: Your profile
s6.desc: Photo, details and your lenses: if you also dance or have another role, switch view here.

s1.title: Your academy
s1.desc: The operating hub: classes, students, plans and videos in one place.

s2.title: Attendance
s2.desc: The month's average in sight, and from here you enter to mark students present in each class.

s3.title: All the modules
s3.desc: Schedules, private lessons, series and videos also from the side menu.

s1.title: Your month at a glance
s1.desc: Active students, sellable plans, weekly classes, attendance and billed, with the comparison against last month.

s2.title: Getting started
s2.desc: The activation checklist: schedule, plan, payment method, team and first student. It disappears on its own once the academy is ready.

s3.title: Today's operation
s3.desc: Today's classes with their bookings and marked attendance. Tap a class to see its roster.

s4.title: The urgent
s4.desc: Receipts to validate and private lessons to confirm: the queue worth bringing to zero each day.

s5.title: What's coming
s5.desc: Plans expiring and your students' birthdays: retaining and celebrating is also operation.

s6.title: All the modules
s6.desc: Payments, plans, team, settings and analytics live in the side menu: you reach the whole console from here.

s7.title: The bell
s7.desc: Notices land here: new receipts, requests and news from your academy.
